verdict.rationale: The justica.gov.pt Empresa Online service page lays out the founder's task in plain, procedural language rather than statute text. It covers who can use the service and how to authenticate, what a foreign corporate partner needs, and how the pact is auto-generated and signed. It also explains the 24-hour name reservation, payment methods with the 48-hour window, the 5-day correction period, the 30-day beneficial-owner deadline, what you receive on completion, and exact fees. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that non-lawyers find the guidance easy to follow, and a working English-language guidance path (the published eportugal.gov.pt English entry URL returns 404, so the living guidance is evidenced only on the Portuguese justica.gov.pt page).
